claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.within_feet_of_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations can currently gate on held or worn state, but not on the user being near a placed item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics.item_relative_spawn_placement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spawned-creature mechanics can express only a coarse activator-rooted range, not nearest-valid-space placement anchored on the item itself.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible..."
